title: RHEL Server Patching with Health Checks
description: Apply all available updates to a RHEL server after verifying sufficient memory and disk space, reboot, then re-validate health and service continuity.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: IP address or hostname of the target RHEL server.

parameters.name: min_free_mem_gb
parameters.description: Minimum required free memory in GB before and after patching.

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum required free disk space in GB on each monitored filesystem.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated mount points to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated filesystem types to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: reboot_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait for machine to reboot and respond.

playbook_output.description: Report containing each validation step's status and any service mismatches after patching.

fields.name: pre_memory_status
fields.description: Outcome of the pre-patch free memory check.

fields.name: pre_disk_status
fields.description: Outcome of the pre-patch disk space check.

fields.name: pre_services_status
fields.description: Number of running services captured before patching.

fields.name: update_status
fields.description: Status of the system update operation.

fields.name: post_memory_status
fields.description: Outcome of the post-patch free memory check.

fields.name: post_disk_status
fields.description: Outcome of the post-patch disk space check.

fields.name: post_services_status
fields.description: Summary of the service comparison (mismatches if any).

fields.name: services_missing
fields.description: List of service names that were running before patching but not after.

fields.name: services_added
fields.description: List of service names that are running after patching but were not before.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch free memory
steps.function: Collect free memory in MB from the target host using ansible.builtin.setup (subset: memory).

steps.name: Check pre-patch memory against threshold
steps.function: Verify that free memory meets the minimum required GB before proceeding.
steps.condition: Free memory (MB) is below the threshold.

steps.name: Record pre-patch memory status
steps.function: Store a PASS status message with the actual free memory and threshold.

computations._pre_mem_status: PASS: {{ _pre_mem_free_mb }} MB free, threshold {{ min_free_mem_gb }} GB

steps.name: Collect pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Run the df command to obtain available bytes and filesystem types for all mounted filesystems.

steps.name: Identify pre-patch filesystems with insufficient space
steps.function: Parse df output, exclude mounts in fs_exclude_list and fstypes in fs_type_exclude_list, and flag those whose available bytes are less than min_free_disk_gb * 1024^3.

computations._disk_issues_pre: Parse each line of _df_raw_pre.stdout_lines into mount point, avail_bytes, fstype; exclude mounts in fs_exclude_list and fstypes in fs_type_exclude_list; keep entries where avail_bytes < min_free_disk_gb * 1024^3; store the list of mount points and their available GB.

steps.name: Check pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Determine whether any monitored filesystem has fallen below the free-space threshold.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Record pre-patch disk status
steps.function: Store a PASS status message indicating all monitored filesystems are above the threshold.

computations._pre_disk_status: PASS: all monitored filesystems have >= {{ min_free_disk_gb }} GB free

steps.name: Gather pre-patch service facts
steps.function: Retrieve all systemd service states from the target host.

steps.name: Extract pre-patch running service list
steps.function: Filter the service facts to obtain a list of services that are currently running and record the count.

computations._pre_running_services: Extract the name of every service where state == 'running' from _pre_services_facts.

steps.name: Apply all system updates
steps.function: Upgrade all installed packages to the latest versions using dnf.

steps.name: Record update status
steps.function: Set a PASS message for the update step.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target host and wait for it to come back online.

steps.name: Record reboot status
steps.function: Set a PASS message for the reboot step.

computations._reboot_status: PASS: Server rebooted and is back online

steps.name: Gather post-patch free memory
steps.function: Collect free memory in MB after patching.

steps.name: Check post-patch memory against threshold
steps.function: Verify that free memory after patching still meets the requirement.
steps.condition: Free memory (MB) is below the threshold.

steps.name: Record post-patch memory status
steps.function: Store a PASS status message with post-patch memory figures.

computations._post_mem_status: PASS: {{ _post_mem_free_mb }} MB free, threshold {{ min_free_mem_gb }} GB

steps.name: Collect post-patch disk space
steps.function: Run the df command again to get post-update disk usage.

steps.name: Identify post-patch filesystems with insufficient space
steps.function: Parse df output after patching, applying the same exclusion rules, and flag filesystems below the threshold.

computations._disk_issues_post: Parse each line of _df_raw_post.stdout_lines; apply the same exclusion logic as in pre-check; keep entries where avail_bytes < min_free_disk_gb * 1024^3.

steps.name: Check post-patch disk space
steps.function: Determine whether any monitored filesystem is now below the free-space threshold.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Record post-patch disk status
steps.function: Store a PASS message for the post-patch disk check.

computations._post_disk_status: PASS: all monitored filesystems have >= {{ min_free_disk_gb }} GB free

steps.name: Gather post-patch service facts
steps.function: Retrieve service states after patching and reboot.

steps.name: Compare pre/post running services
steps.function: Derive lists of services that are missing, added, and a summary status message.

computations._post_running_services: Extract the name of every service where state == 'running' from _post_services_facts.
computations._services_missing: Services present in _pre_running_services but missing in _post_running_services.
computations._services_added: Services present in _post_running_services but not in _pre_running_services.
computations._post_services_status: If no mismatches: 'NO MISMATCH: all pre-patch services are still running.' Otherwise: 'MISMATCH: missing {{ _services_missing | length }} service(s), added {{ _services_added | length }} service(s).'

steps.name: Emit final report
steps.function: Print the structured report containing all check statuses and mismatch details.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block or a failing decide branch. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-patch validation
phases.description: Check that memory and all monitored filesystems have enough free space before applying updates.

phases.name: Pre-patch service inventory
phases.description: Capture the list of currently running services for later comparison.

phases.name: Patch and reboot
phases.description: Apply all system updates, record status, reboot the host, and confirm it comes back up.

phases.name: Post-patch validation
phases.description: Re-check memory, disk space, and compare service lists to detect any discrepancies.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the final structured report to stdout.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any validation fails or a task errors. Records failure and halts execution.
